task.description: WF-02 step 12, RELEASE-VALIDATOR, post-deploy validation of REQ-113 on the PRODUCTION https://sai-team.vercel.app (served commit dd54f43). The owner's rule for this PC (decisions/0110) bars running the check or tests: you run none; you look at the live site. Read context.release_facts first. Do, in this order, and attach the output of each: (1) Production serves the right build: `GET /api/health` (ok, db, role, migrations_pending 0, version dd54f43, node), the response headers of / and /how.html against REQ-109 criterion 4 (the security headers, no-store where the criteria say so), `GET /examples.html` is the uniform 404 (the public set G8 «б»), an unknown path is the uniform 404, a nested /api path is 404. (2) The served files are the released ones: fetch /shared/i18n/texts.js and the pages of production and compare with the files of commit dd54f43 (`git show dd54f43:app/public/...`; byte equality of the served texts.js, how.html, js/pages/demo.js and css/site.css with the repository, after the build's public-set step if it rewrites them: say what differs and why; the public build must hide kk and the order texts: no `order_` key and no kk value in the served module). The 15 REQ-113 values in ru and en are in the served module exactly as the requirement writes them (use your own script over the module text, never the stand of an earlier step). The static ru text of how.html carries the block, the plan note, the stage marks and the invitation sentence «Способа получить приглашение пока нет.». (3) A real browser on production (Chrome through the debugging protocol, headless, one context per cell, a fresh temporary profile; one browser at a time): the demo to its result with the recommended answers and with five «Не знаю» (the page's own demo requests only; the demo POST is the page's own request: allowed, nothing else is posted), and how.html: in ru and en, at 390×844 and 1470×784, light and dark: the block «Что работает сейчас»/«What works now» is there once on the result and once on how.html, three rows with their marks (ru «Работает» / «Пока нет», en «Working» / «Not yet»), the closing text of four sentences with the new one, no console error, no failed request except the declared ones, no horizontal scroll, the block above the button «Описать идею» on the result, the button opens the part «Как описать идею». Take screenshots into your own folder under <scratch> and open at least four. (4) The two earlier landing facts still hold on production (REQ-111 and REQ-112 criteria that name production: the closed pages, the demo, the office stage page /office/ answers, the language buttons RU and EN only, kk hidden by ?lang=kk showing Russian). (5) The incident: read the facts, confirm from what you can see (the health version, the file lists are not visible to you; say what you could confirm: the site answers 200 now) and write it plainly in the record with the lesson (the deploy command runs inside the app folder of the export; the smoke check caught it within the same minutes). Be economical: one script for the GET checks, one for the browser, compact tables. result.summary: Post-deploy validation of REQ-113 on https://sai-team.vercel.app, served commit dd54f43 (health version dd54f43, migrations_pending 0). Verdict PASS for the production state. 1) Right build: /api/health ok; the eight REQ-109 security headers are byte equal on all 12 addresses, /api answers carry no-store; /examples.html, /nope and /office/ are the uniform 404, /api/a/b and /api/nope are 404 {error:not_found}. 2) Served files: site.css and demo.js equal the repository byte for byte; texts.js and how.html equal the output of the project's own public build step run by me on a copy of dd54f43 outside the project; 21 of 21 files of that output served byte for byte; the served module has LANGS [ru,en], no order_ key, no kk value, no idea_panel_fine; the 15 REQ-113 keys, 30 of 30 ru and en values, equal the requirement; the static ru how.html carries the block, the plan note, the stage marks and the sentence about the missing way to get an invitation. 3) Real Chrome 157 on production: 442 of 442 checks in the final run (how.html and the demo result, recommended answers and five 'Не знаю', ru and en, 1470x784 and 390x844, light and dark): the block once on the result and on how.html, three rows with the marks (ru Работает / Пока нет, en Working / Not yet), closing text of four sentences, the exact lead, no grey line, label 'Учтено ответов' with its sentence, stage marks, the two notes, block above 'Описать идею' (DOM order and edges), the button opens 'Как описать идею', block top at y 557 at 390x844, no horizontal scroll, no console error, no failed request, only the page's own POST /api/demo/result. 24 screenshots, six opened and read. 4) Landing facts hold: examples closed, demo works, scene and stage press work, RU and EN buttons only, ?lang=kk shows Russian on /, /how.html and /demo.html. 5) Incident of the first deploy recorded plainly with the lesson; what I could confirm is that the site answers 200 now and serves the exact build output; the 404 window and the file counts are not visible to me. GitHub runs app 45075584788 and check 45075584839 on dd54f43 read as success (gh run view, read-only). The record is docs/uat/M1WORDS-20261122-02-prod.md. I ran no test, no check, no Vercel command, no git write.
